title: Use a ferro rod
kid_text: Pull the rod back. A grown-up scrapes.

steps.text: Put the ferro rod in the nest.
Press the scraper hard on the rod.
Pull the rod back, not the scraper.
Aim the sparks into the nest.
Blow gently when you see a glow.

mistakes.text: You push the scraper into the nest.
You blow so hard the glow dies.
